scope: for each representable row of the structure grounding, applies the declared status mapping, code mapping and provenance declaration; missing declarations become requests to the author of the declaration and nothing is guessed

facts.statement: final: the observation is complete and needs no further action; released or signed states are represented with Provenance
facts.marker: The observation is complete and there are no further actions needed

facts.statement: amended: modified after being final, including updates and corrections
facts.marker: Subsequent to being Final, the observation has been modified subsequent

facts.statement: corrected: modified after being final to correct an error
facts.marker: to correct an error in the test result

facts.statement: a CodeableConcept is a text description and/or a list of Codings
facts.marker: a text description and/or a list of Codings

facts.statement: Provenance.agent is 1..* and agent.who is 1..1 referencing one of Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Organization, CareTeam, Patient, Device, RelatedPerson
facts.marker: The agent that participated in the event

facts.statement: Provenance.target is 1..* and usually version specific

facts.marker: When the activity was recorded / updated

steps: 1 + M_g + 3 per query + 1; M_g is the full structure grounding fee and the grounding is called once at budget M_g and must use exactly M_g; fees are prepaid, never refunded
answers: results keep the grounding row and add observation; certificate is always not_certified and inferred information is always empty
limitations: diagnostic only; one structure; the status and code mappings and the reviewer type are declarations by the author and are never decided here; no revision entity, activity code, role or signature; no conformance claim
